name: ai.yonyon/yonyon
title: Yonatan Gross (yonyon.ai)
description: Ask about Yonatan Gross, browse his projects, and book an intro call. No sign-in.

tools.name: ask_yonatan
tools.description: Use this when a user asks about Yonatan Gross specifically (his work, projects, services, availability, or fit). Returns a grounded answer as text from the same model that powers the site chat.

tools.name: browse_projects
tools.description: Use this when a user asks what Yonatan has built or wants proof of production AI experience with a given stack. Returns his portfolio projects, each with a name, a one-line description and a link.

query.description: Optional keyword filter matched against project names and descriptions.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return (default: all).

tools.name: book_intro_call
tools.description: Use this when a user wants to book a free 15-minute intro call with Yonatan to scope a build or discuss consulting. It books for real, in three calls: (1) with no slot it returns up to 5 free slots; (2) with slot, name and email it re-checks the slot and returns needs_confirmation with a confirm_token, booking nothing; show the slot to the person and get their yes; (3) the same slot, name and email plus confirm_token creates the Cal booking. The token lasts 10 minutes, works once, and is bound to that slot and email.

name.description: The attendee's full name. Required with a slot.

email.description: The attendee's email; Cal sends the invite here. Required with a slot.

slot.description: ISO 8601 start time, taken from the slots list. Omit it to list free slots.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the attendee. Default Asia/Jerusalem.

notes.description: Optional: what the call is about.

confirm_token.description: The token from the needs_confirmation answer. Send it only after the person said yes; it creates the booking.

topic.description: Optional: what the call is about. Prefills the booking view; to store it on the booking, send it as notes.

preferred_day.description: Optional, with no slot: a weekday name or ISO date the person asked for. The booking view puts matching times first.

preferred_part.description: Optional, with no slot: the part of day the person asked for. The booking view puts matching times first.

tools.name: list_intro_slots
tools.description: Use this when the booking view needs every open intro-call time. It returns the open start times of the next two weeks grouped by local day, with the server clock and the booking page link. For the app only: a model uses book_intro_call.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the attendee. Default Asia/Jerusalem.
